param: B Constant influx (birth/recruitment) rate into susceptible human hosts
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes (vectors)
βₕ(a) Age-dependent transmission/contact rate from infectious mosquitoes to susceptible humans (vector-to-host)
k(a) Age-dependent progression rate from exposed humans to infectious humans (end of latent period)
γ₁(a) Age-dependent recovery rate of symptomatic infectious humans
γ₂(a) Age-dependent recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious humans
βᵥ(a) Age-dependent transmission rate from infectious human hosts to susceptible mosquitoes (host-to-vector)
ρ Probability an exposed human becomes symptomatic infectious (fraction progressing to Iₕ); (1-ρ) becomes asymptomatic Aₕ
σ Reinfection intensity factor: scales contact rate for reinfection of asymptomatic humans leading to symptomatic infection
Nₕ(t) Total human population size at time t (used in standard incidence normalization)
